2610.04156.title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
2610.04156.paper_summary: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.
2610.04156.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理在臨床文本轉 SQL 應用中能夠自主推理多個步驟，但無法評估自己的推理或輸出是否可信。在醫療等高槓桿應用中，這帶來了關鍵風險，因為系統錯誤可能代價高昂。這些可靠性失敗也是資源失敗：不正確的推理軌跡會消耗計算預算在必須被丟棄的輸出上。我們介紹了 Sentinel，一種基於軌跡派生的分類器信心層，它分析代理的推理、代碼和數據庫輸出，以在三個點決定是否停止：在代理運行之前拒絕無法回答的問題、中途停止注定失敗的軌跡，以及在交付時不提供不可信的答案。在這裡，利用 Chow 的法則，我們在 EHRSQL 共享任務的可靠性分數下優化決策，該分數對給定效用權重的不正確答案進行懲罰，並發現在基準 EHRSQL 上，當錯誤具有低效用權重時，Sentinel 將此分數從 +0.08 提升至 +0.24，遠高於拒絕每個問題所獲得的 +0.03，交付答案的準確率從 54% 上升至 69%，而覆蓋率從 84% 下降至 55%。在更高風險的情況下，我們測試的代理很少能夠可靠地回答問題，Sentinel 自行檢測到這一點，保持在同樣的 +0.03，而未監控的代理得分為 -3.02。相同的停止決策減少了計算：在低風險下，系統仍然能回答問題，Sentinel 在幾乎沒有可靠性成本的情況下消除了 13-28% 的代理步驟。
